After Kh7, White has Rxf7# immediately (checkmate with the rook). So both king moves lead to mate very quickly!

**Best move:** Qxf8+

**Main line:** Qxf8+ Kxf8 Rb8+ Rc8 Rxc8#

**Motif:** fork (the queen checks the king and attacks f7, forcing the king to capture, then the rook delivers mate on b8)

**Coaching note (80 words max):**

Look for forcing moves first—checks and captures. Your queen on e7 can capture Black's queen with check (Qxf8+). After Black recaptures with the king, the back rank becomes weak. Your rook delivers check with Rb8+, forcing Black's rook to block on c8, where it's trapped. The rook recapture Rxc8# is checkmate because the king on f8 has no escape squares. Always consider how checks create weaknesses for follow-up tactics.
